\begin{proof}[Proof of Theorem~\ref{thm:types}]
Simple arrow-type inhabitation with context is in PSPACE, and already the closed case is PSPACE-hard, by the classical implicational intuitionistic-logic classification~\cite{statman,svejdar} and Curry--Howard. Every inhabited simple type has an $\eta$-long $\beta$-normal inhabitant. Apply Lemma~\ref{lem:frontier}, then invoke a polynomial-space inhabitation procedure on each frontier obligation sequentially, reusing its workspace. Enumerate the polynomially many potential completions of a partial head index, again sequentially. Polynomial space is closed under these finite conjunctions and disjunctions. This proves membership.
